top.line: Cloudflare runs agents and controls them; its own Agent Access Model leaves room for a signed record of each agent's mandate.
top.para: From Cloudflare's docs and blog: the Agents SDK, sandboxes, AI Gateway and remote MCP on one side; Access for MCP, WriteGuard, DLP and Web Bot Auth on the other. Controls exist at every layer but default open. Cloudflare's own posts say a scope only says what an agent was allowed to do, not who answers when it gets it wrong. An Agent Behaviour Policy is that record.

in-short.line: Two roles, controls at every layer, open defaults, Cloudflare naming the gap, the policy as the record.
in-short.para: Six points; nothing run on Cloudflare yet.

two-roles.line: Where agents run, and where they are controlled, often in one account.
two-roles.para: Agents SDK, Workflows, Sandbox, Browser Run, AI Gateway, OAuth for MCP; Access, the AI security report, DLP, AI Security for Apps, Web Bot Auth.

controls.line: Seven controls as barriers, each with its gap.
controls.para: Portal tools on by default, scopes advertised not enforced, approvals chosen by the developer, caps on how much not what, bindings without a why, inspection of routed traffic only, identity not mandate.

joe.line: Joe's agent closes thousands of tickets with Joe's permissions.
joe.para: WriteGuard adds client context and risk tiers, but the agent's reach is its human's; only the policy writes down its narrower job.

case.line: Cloudflare's Agent Access Model and trusted-delegation post make the case for a mandate.
case.para: Declared task scope, default deny, and someone who answers: the mandate, barriers and sign-off of a policy.

layers.line: Read, set, gate, attest: Cloudflare has pieces at every layer.
layers.para: The missing piece is the signed mandate the logs are checked against.

offer.line: A policy per agent read from real configuration, templates, a check of open defaults, a gate from the policy.

limits.line: Not run on Cloudflare; status as each page states; Joe is Cloudflare's example, the mandate ours.
limits.para: No relationship beyond being a customer.

sources.line: Cloudflare docs and three blog posts, riskmandate.ai and earlier articles.
